about: lib/head-spools.js link(machines, machineId, head, spoolId) and unlink(machines, machineId, head): a spool is in at most one head of one printer. Each case gives the machines' headSpools before (by machine id), the call, and want: the headSpools after, the heads the spool was taken out of, and the machines changed. shown(linked, reportsEmpty) has its own list. Synthetic ids; the first case is Baby U1's double link from the watched run, Nov 27 2026.

cases.why: Baby U1, Nov 27: the spool moved from head 1 to head 2 and was linked again; it must leave head 1
a spool linked on another printer comes off it
a head that held another spool now holds this one; the other spool is simply no longer in a head
linking what is already there changes nothing
a machine with no headSpools yet gets one
a head that is not a number is refused, nothing changes
an unknown machine is refused, and the spool is NOT taken off its head elsewhere
unlink takes the head's spool out, and only that head

shown.about: shown(linkedSpoolId, reportsEmpty): an empty read keeps the link and says so; only an ANSWERED empty head counts.

cases.why: linked, the printer says the head is empty: taken out
the printer did not answer: still linked
